# THE HUNTER AND THE WORLD
Ivan Petrovic

## Preface

This book grew out of many conversations about the hunter and the forest, and about the silence that follows a long walk.

## 1. Arrival

Milan arrived in the village at dawn. London was far away, and Ana waited for Milan near the old bridge.

## 2. The Storm

The storm came without warning. Milan looked at the sky and remembered the words of the hunter.

## Notes

This section contains notes and explanations about the hunter, the village, and the forest.
